behavior: Every spar starts at full attribute-based health and stamina, with fresh body parts and effort state.
World health and energy do not gate a spar or reduce opening capacity.
Winning, losing or surrendering a spar does not deduct world health or energy.
Checkpointing or resuming the same bout preserves its damage and exhaustion.
scope: Equipment durability and NPC world grievance duels retain their existing rules.
Previously depleted global values remain stored, but no longer affect spar eligibility or starting resources.
